recipes.name: Shortbread
method: Heat the oven to {oven} and line a shallow tin.
Rub the butter into the flour and sugar until the mixture clumps together.
Press it into the tin, prick it all over and bake for 30 minutes until pale golden.
Cut into fingers while warm and leave to cool in the tin.

recipes.name: Pancakes
method: Whisk the flour, eggs and half the milk into a smooth batter.
Whisk in the rest of the milk and rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Fry a thin layer of batter in a hot greased pan, about a minute a side.

recipes.name: Tomato soup
method: Soften the chopped onion in a large pan for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and the stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season to taste.

recipes.name: Lemonade
method: Warm the sugar in a quarter of the water until it dissolves.
Add the juice of the lemons and the rest of the water.
Chill for an hour and serve over ice.
